subject: English
passage: Oil paint dries slowly—sometimes taking several days to become touch-dry on the canvas—but it dries far more slowly than watercolor, which can feel dry within minutes of application. The difference between these drying times is largely ______ of the fact that the chemical processes that harden an oil film proceed through gradual oxidation, whereas watercolor simply loses its water through evaporation.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of the difference in drying times between oil paint and watercolor. As used in this context, 'a consequence' means a result or effect of something. The text establishes that oil paint dries far more slowly than watercolor and then explains that oil films harden through gradual oxidation while watercolors dry through evaporation. This context supports the idea that the difference in drying times is a consequence of—or results from—the fact that these two chemical processes operate at very different rates.
